delete.title: Deleting messages
delete.hint: The company chooses what happens when someone deletes a message they wrote. The choice applies to the current company only.
delete.label: When a message is deleted
delete.placeholder: Keep a “this message was deleted” line
delete.placeholderHint: The text and files are cleared and the message keeps its place, so replies, pins and the order of messages stay as they are.
delete.permanentHint: The message and its files are removed for everyone and leave no trace in the conversation.
